title: A request or a block? CLAUDE.md versus hook, four real runs
notes: Week 1, series Does it hold?. Own English recording hook-env-en: four runs twice each. L3 (CLAUDE.md and hook) was the first design for the hook; because Claude already refused over the CLAUDE.md and the hook never fired, L4 (hook only) was added. All four runs are in the video.

hook_candidates.spoken: Is a rule in CLAUDE.md enough to stop Claude Code from changing your .env file?
A rule in CLAUDE.md is a block? According to the docs, it is only context.
The hook blocked the edit even though Claude tried to make it.
Without a rule, Claude changed the .env file right away.
Four real runs: no rule, request, request and hook, hook only.

sources.title: How Claude remembers your project: Claude reads CLAUDE.md files at the start of every session; Claude treats them as context, not enforced configuration; to block an action regardless of what Claude decides, use a PreToolUse hook; target under 200 lines per CLAUDE.md file; files over 200 lines consume more context and may reduce adherence; run /init to generate a starting CLAUDE.md
sources.label: Claude Code docs, Memory

sources.title: Automate actions with hooks: hooks give deterministic control, certain actions always happen rather than relying on the LLM to choose to run them; a PreToolUse hook that exits with code 2 blocks the edit; hooks can format files after edits

unverified: Whether Claude follows the CLAUDE.md request with other wording, longer sessions or other models: not tested. The docs do not guarantee it.
The hook is a small sample script (schutz.js) in Node; it only checks Edit and Write.

layout.description: Real run, recorded on Nov 2, 2026 with Claude Code 2.1.309 (model claude-haiku-5-5). Four runs, each twice: without a rule, Claude set DEBUG=true in .env. With the request in CLAUDE.md, Claude refused, also in the run with an extra hook. With the hook only, Claude tried the edit, and the PreToolUse hook blocked it with exit code 2.
layout.companion_text: Base command per run: claude -p "<Prompt>" --model haiku --output-format stream-json --verbose --setting-sources project,local --strict-mcp-config --disable-slash-commands --no-session-persistence --tools Read,Edit,Write. CLAUDE.md: 'Never change the file .env.' Hook in .claude/settings.json: PreToolUse, matcher Edit|Write, node .claude/hooks/schutz.js (exit code 2 for .env). Source: Claude Code docs, Memory and Hooks, retrieved Nov 2, 2026. Paths shortened in the frame (test folder = .). Behaviour can change with version and model. Not an official Anthropic channel.

beats.spoken: Is a rule in CLAUDE.md enough to stop Claude Code from changing your .env file, or do you need a hook? Four real runs.
The request is one line in CLAUDE.md. The docs call these files context, not enforced configuration, and point to a hook for blocking.

data.quote: Claude treats them as context, not enforced configuration.
data.translation: Context, not a setting that is enforced.

beats.spoken: The hook lives in settings.json. Before every edit it checks the path, and for .env it stops with exit code two.

data.quote: … certain actions always happen rather than relying on the LLM to choose to run them.
data.translation: It always happens, whatever the model decides.

beats.spoken: Run one, no rule. Claude read the file, made one edit and set DEBUG to true. The other lines stayed as they were.
Run two, with the request in CLAUDE.md. Claude refused without calling a tool and pointed to the project rule. It suggested editing the file yourself or changing the rule.
Run three, request and hook. Again Claude refused because of the CLAUDE.md. The hook never got its turn.
Run four, hook only. Claude tried the edit, the hook blocked it, and the file stayed unchanged. Claude then stopped and did not try another way to write the file.
All runs ran twice, with the same result. Here Claude followed the request, but the docs do not guarantee that. The hook held when Claude tried. Two layers, two different jobs.

data.headline: 4 runs, twice each
data.note: Reliable block: a PreToolUse hook with exit code 2.

beats.spoken: Requests go in CLAUDE.md, bans go in a hook. Follow Promptwerk for more Claude workflows, step by step.

data.statement: Requests in CLAUDE.md, bans in a hook.
